summary: Graviton (ARM) CPU inference routing is implemented for pytorch and tensorflow; nothing is committed. Changes: fw_utils.py gains GRAVITON_ALLOWED_TARGET_INSTANCE_FAMILY and GRAVITON_ALLOWED_FRAMEWORKS; image_uris.py adds _get_image_scope_from_instance_type (run before config load) and the -sagemaker suffix for <framework>-inference-graviton; pytorch.json and tensorflow.json each gain one inference_graviton section (additions only); tests add graviton_framework_uri in expected_uris.py, two fixtures in conftest.py, and test_graviton.py. Verification: both new Graviton tests pass; image URI suite (663) passes; test_fw_utils, tensorflow/huggingface/training_compiler unit tests (1629 passed) and test_pytorch.py (945 passed) pass; all three import orders succeed. test_retrieve.py and jumpstart (33 tests) pass only with a temporary mock shim, because the shared venv lacks the mock package; the shim was removed. Choices to review: helper name _get_image_scope_from_instance_type; Elastic Inference is not excluded, so an EI request with a Graviton instance type still routes to Graviton; the suffix rule keys on the repository name pattern rather than hard-coded names.
